decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of 06/11/2025.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:
[Unnumbered Location Plan, 101rB Ground Floor, 200 Basement Plan Existing, 200 Basement Proposed, 203 Acoustic Floor and Ceiling Details, Ceiling and wall boards and acoustic rubber materials information, Planning Report written by Jonathan Philips, Flood Risk Assessment 0170 - FRA- 003, Fire Safety Reasonable Exception Statement, Noise Impact Assessment 24101238r1 and The Living Room Brochure. Received: 23/06/2025
1.0 Revision 00 and Addendum Report written by Jonathan Philips. Received: 19/08/2025
Unnumbered Rear Elevation Existing, Unnumbered Ground Floor Plan and Unnumbered First Floor Plan. Received: 27/08/2025
Unnumbered Rear Elevation Proposed, Unnumbered Ground Floor Plan Proposed and Unnumbered First Floor Plan Proposed. Received: 13/10/2025
SGL3, Unnumbered Basement Plan Existing, Unnumbered Basement Proposed and Planning Support Statement. Received: 13/02/2026
Noise Impact Assessment. Received: 10/07/2026].

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The uses of the property hereby approved shall only be operational between 9am to 1am on Sundays to Thursdays and 9am to 1:30am on Fridays and Saturdays, except that the operation hours of the basement would be extended to 9am to 2:30am on Fridays and Saturdays within 12 moths from the date of this decision and the development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the Noise Impact Assessment received on 10/07/2026.
Reason: To safeguard the amenity of surrounding residential neighbours, in accordance with policies CC1 and CC2 of the Local Plan.
Condition : 4 - The noise management policy, dispersal policy and mitigation strategies shall be carried out in accordance with the hereby approved Construction Traffic Management Plan, any alterations or amendments must be agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions, in accordance with policies EQ5, CC1 and CC2 of the Local Plan.
Condition : 5 - Development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the drainage design details approved on 27/04/2026 under planning reference P/2026/0391.
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.
description: Variation of condition 3 (opening hours) to allow the addition of one hour to the opening hours of the basement, 0900-0100 on Sundays to Thursdays and 0900-0230 on Fridays and Saturdays for 12 months of planning permission P/2025/1945 approved 07/11/2025 for the retrospective application for the change of use of the existing food takeaway business and restaurant into a lounge bar on the basement floor and restaurant on the ground floor of 299 to 303 Chiswick High Road.
